headline: 991 deaths: Measles outbreak kills 4 children in 24 hours in Bangladesh
summary: The total death toll from measles and measles-like symptoms has reached 991 since March 15, according to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).
details: Four children died within 24 hours (from Friday morning to Saturday morning) due to measles and related symptoms, according to a regular report from the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).
During the same 24-hour period, 917 new cases of measles and measles-like symptoms were reported across the country.
The DGHS report specifies that one child died from confirmed measles, while three others died from symptoms associated with the virus.
Since March 15, a total of 991 people have died from measles and measles-like symptoms, including 100 confirmed cases of measles.
The outbreak continues to claim lives, with nearly a thousand deaths recorded in less than six months.
caption:
Nearly 1,000 children have died from measles in Bangladesh since March. 4 more died in just 24 hours.

Four children died within 24 hours (from Friday morning to Saturday morning) due to measles and related symptoms, according to a regular report from the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).

During the same 24-hour period, 917 new cases of measles and measles-like symptoms were reported across the country.

The DGHS report specifies that one child died from confirmed measles, while three others died from symptoms associated with the virus.

Since March 15, a total of 991 people have died from measles and measles-like symptoms, including 100 confirmed cases of measles.

The outbreak continues to claim lives, with nearly a thousand deaths recorded in less than six months.

headline: 3 killed in head-on collision between auto-rickshaw and van in Gazipur
summary: A tragic accident in Kaliakair claimed three lives and left two others injured after a CNG-run auto-rickshaw collided with a covered van.
details: Three people were killed and two others injured in a head-on collision between a CNG-run auto-rickshaw and a covered van in Kaliakair, Gazipur, this morning.
The accident occurred around noon in the Chairman Bari area of Kanchanpur on the Kaliakair–Fulbaria–Mawna regional road.

According to the officer-in-charge of Kaliakair Police Station, the auto-rickshaw was carrying four passengers and heading towards Mawna Chowrasta in Sreepur when it hit the van coming from the opposite direction.
Locals rescued the injured and rushed them to Kaliakair Upazila Health Complex, where doctors declared three of them dead.
One of the deceased has been identified as 26-year-old Asadullah, while the identities of the others are still being confirmed.
caption:
3 people killed in a head-on collision in Gazipur. A routine trip turned tragic this morning.

Three people were killed and two others injured in a head-on collision between a CNG-run auto-rickshaw and a covered van in Kaliakair, Gazipur, this morning.

The accident occurred around noon in the Chairman Bari area of Kanchanpur on the Kaliakair–Fulbaria–Mawna regional road.

According to the officer-in-charge of Kaliakair Police Station, the auto-rickshaw was carrying four passengers and heading towards Mawna Chowrasta in Sreepur when it hit the van coming from the opposite direction.

Locals rescued the injured and rushed them to Kaliakair Upazila Health Complex, where doctors declared three of them dead.

One of the deceased has been identified as 26-year-old Asadullah, while the identities of the others are still being confirmed.
